expectation: Membrane/junctional ring staining in epithelial cells, chicken-wire pattern at cell borders, lining glands and crypts (this looks like gut mucosa); stroma and lymphoid cells largely negative; very common in epithelium.
observed: A: yellow signal fills the epithelial mucosa and follows gland architecture, with stroma dark and a few bright specks in the background. B and C: crisp honeycomb membrane rings between cells, lining a gland lumen with a polarized epithelial layer. D: pericellular outlines around the nuclei. E1: the same junctional ring pattern in epithelium. E2 panCK is hazy and diffuse, so E3 adds little.
why: Clear junctional membrane chicken-wire in epithelial glands, with stroma negative, matches E-cadherin.
